Monica,

Thanks — attaching the redlines we received from our legal and the final Order Form PDF. Two quick asks before we kick off DocuSign:

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — signature routing and authority

Jeff — thanks for the redlines. Short answers up front: we can do sequential or simultaneous signing; we prefer Acme initiate and Redwood countersigns (sequential) for audit clarity, but simultaneous is fine if you need quicker turnaround.

To help us set the envelope correctly, please confirm the following by EOD:
- Primary signer name and title for Acme (legal/COO).
- Signer email to receive the DocuSign link (if using a shared procurement inbox, please provide the mailbox address and the person who will click-sign).
- Whether Acme requires a witness or notarization (and whether the witness signs in-person or e-notary).

Priyom — quick ask for legal: we had a few redline items in Section 7 (data residency) and Section 11 (indemnity). If you can confirm the final MSA_v3_redlines.pdf is acceptable, we can prepare the envelope with the conditional checkbox and a DPA acknowledgement. Also, can you add instructions for corporate attestation evidence (registry snippet / board resolution) to the envelope as a required attachment field?

I’ve attached a short execution-instructions.pdf that shows our recommended sequencing and envelope settings (tags for signature, initial, and a required "Corporate Attestation" upload). Laura — FYI for onboarding and post-signing handoff — can you queue the customer success kickoff once we have countersigned clean copies?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Monica / team — reviewed the attached MSA_v3_redlines.pdf and OrderForm_ACM_v2.pdf. High-level notes: 

- Acceptable to proceed with the redlines as marked, subject to final execution with the DPA acknowledgement checkbox inside the envelope.
- Execution sequencing: recommend Acme signs first, Redwood then signs (sequential). This gives a clean audit trail and prevents execution on materially different copies.
- Envelope requirements: include a required file upload field for "Corporate Attestation (registry excerpt or board minute)" that our intake team can verify before countersign. If Acme prefers to provide a written PO after countersign, ensure the payment terms in the Order Form reflect that.
- Evidence archiving: after countersign we need a timestamped clean copy (PDF) and the envelope audit trail exported to our contract repo.

I’ve attached a short note with the envelope setup we need: legal_countersign_instructions.txt — it contains field names, checkbox ids, and how to map the contract version to our docstore key.

Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Also, Acme requires a witness attestation for this agreement (international operations). Karen will sign electronically; witness will be an in-person attestation. Can you add an optional witness signature field and a "Witness attest: in-person" checkbox?

Thanks,
Jeff
